title: Design: Edit Customer shows the saved Bill Invoices To and its help line
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer A (it pays for others) and customer B, with customer A saved as customer B's Bill Invoices To in Edit Customer.
  • Give customer B an Address 2 (for example Apt. 891).
  • Start on customer B's page.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p1-07-after-saved-default.png, bt-p1-06-before-edit-customer.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Click the edit icon on customer B's card.
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 pixels wide.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Bill Invoices To shows customer A's name, between Credit Terms | Credit Limit and Sales Representative.
  • Directly under the field, in small grey text: "New work orders and part sales bill to this customer. Existing ones don't change."
  • Address 2 shows with its value and an x at its right.

Step 2:

  • The field, its help line and the x stay in place and nothing wraps or overlaps.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12304 (Story 2, Bill Invoices To in New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S2-R1: “New Customer and Edit Customer show a searchable "Bill Invoices To" field, reading "This customer" until another customer is picked.”
  • S2-R3: “Edit Customer shows the help line "New work orders and part sales bill to this customer. Existing ones don't change." under the field.”
  • S2-R8: “A customer whose Address 2 holds a value opens with Address 2 showing, even when Address 1 is empty.”
  • S2-R7: “A shown Address 2 has an x button (tooltip "Remove Address 2") that clears and hides it; nothing is saved until Save.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "1 Set a customer's default Bill To", pictures "Saved default" (This build), "Edit Customer" (Production (v26.45.2.1)).
